Seminar

The Sudo Execute

An introductory Linux seminar at HKBK with Mr. Shijil TV, a member of FSMK. Students explored why GNU/Linux is used and how the command line gives users a direct way to work with a system.

Session details

Date
Wednesday, 1 April 2026
Time
10:00 am–12:30 pm IST
Venue
CSE Seminar Hall
Mentor
Mr. Shijil TV · FSMK, Bengaluru

What the session covered

An introduction to Linux

Where Linux appears in everyday computing and the reasons people choose to use it.

Command line and graphical interfaces

The session compared the CLI and GUI as ways to interact with a computer.

Linux in practice

Examples of where Linux is used, with discussion about control, stability and scale.
